questions.prompt: A follower receives a RequestVote for its current term, but it has already voted for a different candidate in that term. What does it reply?
options: VoteGranted: false, because it votes at most once per term
VoteGranted: true, because the newer request overrides the old vote
VoteGranted: true only if the new candidate has a longer log
It does not reply at all
questions.explanation: Votes are first-come-first-served and limited to one per term; that limit, combined with majority overlap, gives Election Safety. A longer log does not let a server change its vote: log comparison only decides whether a vote may be granted, never whether one may be revoked.

questions.prompt: A candidate in term 4 receives an AppendEntries from another server claiming to be leader with term 4. What should it do?
options: Reject it, since a candidate only accepts messages with a strictly higher term
Start a new election in term 5
Recognise the sender as leader and return to follower
Keep collecting votes and compare totals with the other leader
questions.explanation: If the leader's term is at least as large as the candidate's currentTerm, the leader is legitimate (there is at most one leader per term), so the candidate steps down. Only a strictly smaller term is rejected.

questions.prompt: Why does a candidate check that its currentTerm still equals the election's term before counting a granted vote?
options: Because a vote from an earlier election might otherwise be counted toward a later one
Because RPC replies can be forged
Because votes must be persisted in term order
Because the leader needs the term to initialise nextIndex
questions.explanation: Replies can arrive late. If the candidate has since moved to a new term, a stale grant was cast for a different election and counting it could give a false majority. Forgery is outside Raft's non-Byzantine failure model.

diagrams.title: A leader election in a five-server cluster
diagrams.source:
title A Raft leader election

s1 "Server 1" state follower
s2 "Server 2" state follower
s3 "Server 3" state follower
s4 "Server 4" state follower
s5 "Server 5" state follower
term  "S1 current term" counter 1
votes "Votes for S1" counter 0

s1 -> s2, s3, s4, s5
s2, s3, s4, s5 -> s1

style follower #8a94a6
style candidate #f2a93b
style leader #4caf7a
style granted #4caf7a

# Five followers in term 1. The old leader has crashed, so heartbeats have stopped.
pause "Each follower runs its own randomized election timer, 150 to 300 ms."

# S1's election timeout fires first, so it becomes a candidate for term 2.
s1 : candidate  "No AppendEntries arrived before the timer expired."
term +1  "currentTerm goes from 1 to 2 and is written to stable storage."
votes +1  "A candidate always votes for itself: votedFor = S1, persisted."

# S1 asks every other server for its vote with RequestVote.
together
  new rv2 at s1
  new rv3 at s1
  new rv4 at s1
  new rv5 at s1
together stagger 100ms
  rv2 -> s2
  rv3 -> s3
  rv4 -> s4
  rv5 -> s5
pause "Each request carries term 2, candidateId, lastLogIndex and lastLogTerm."

# S2 and S3 see a newer term and an up-to-date log, so they grant their votes.
together
  remove rv2
  remove rv3
  new ok2 at s2 granted
  new ok3 at s3 granted
together stagger 150ms
  ok2 -> s1
  ok3 -> s1
votes +2  "Each voter records votedFor = S1 before replying, so it cannot vote twice in term 2."

# Three of five votes is a majority, so S1 becomes leader for term 2.
together
  remove ok2
  remove ok3
s1 : leader  "Two candidates cannot both get 3 of 5 votes in the same term."

# The late votes from S4 and S5 still arrive, but S1 has already won.
together
  remove rv4
  remove rv5
  new ok4 at s4 granted
  new ok5 at s5 granted
together stagger 100ms
  ok4 -> s1
  ok5 -> s1
votes +2  "Extra votes change nothing; a majority was enough."
together
  remove ok4
  remove ok5

# The new leader sends empty AppendEntries heartbeats to assert its authority.
together
  new hb2 at s1
  new hb3 at s1
  new hb4 at s1
  new hb5 at s1
together stagger 80ms
  hb2 -> s2
  hb3 -> s3
  hb4 -> s4
  hb5 -> s5
pause "Each follower adopts term 2 and resets its election timer, so no new election starts."
